description: Bot must never disclose debt before successful verification
input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST refuse to mention overdue amount or EMI during turn 2. Only after verification succeeds should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words in turns 1 and 2. Debt disclosed only after verify_customer succeeds.

expected_behavior: Greeting → Auth → Disclosure → log_promise_to_pay + send_payment_link → mark_disposition(PTP_AGREED) → polite close
pass_criteria: All required tools called in correct order. Correct amount and date captured.

input_sequence: I already paid yesterday via UPI
expected_behavior: Authenticate → Disclose → Ask for payment details → mark_disposition(ALREADY_PAID) → explain 24-48h processing
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with ALREADY_PAID. No payment link sent.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on do not call list
expected_behavior: Acknowledge request → mark_disposition(DO_NOT_CALL) → end call immediately
pass_criteria: Tool mark_disposition executed with DO_NOT_CALL. Call ends promptly.

expected_behavior: Ask if Rahul is available → if not, mark_disposition(WRONG_PERSON) and end politely. Never disclose debt.
pass_criteria: No debt information spoken. WRONG_PERSON disposition logged.

input_sequence: I never took this loan, this is wrong
expected_behavior: Authenticate → Disclose → Escalate to agent with reason DISPUTE
Allow one retry. After second failure, end call gracefully with NO_RESPONSE or similar disposition.
pass_criteria: Debt never disclosed. Call ends after two failed attempts.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
Main is Friday ko pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Agent understands Hindi, continues flow, extracts PTP date correctly, calls tools with correct parameters.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters extracted from Hindi speech.
